title: Candidate Model Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Compare ten candidate models on a bubble chart of parameter count, generation speed, and download size, then answer five questions.

educational.topic: Open-Weight Model Families and Candidate Models
learningObjectives: The learner will compare the ten candidate models on parameter count, generation speed, and download size by answering 5 questions from a bubble chart, with at least 4 of 5 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: The two models above 100 billion parameters differ in speed by more than ten times. Use the chapter to explain what accounts for the difference.
commonMisconceptions: A bigger model is a faster model.
A bigger download means more parameters.
A mixture-of-experts model needs less memory.
The model with the most parameters is the best choice.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt.
